envelope.description: Settle missing files and list stale held files in the freshness compute

body.title: Settle missing files and list stale held files in the freshness compute
body.summary: In src/workflow/code-review/freshness.ts add the selection and requestedAt seams to FreshnessDeps and unindexedFiles to FreshnessResult. Settle a file whose mtime is 0 first (not stale, not listed, no seam consulted). Keep the watermark comparison for a file with entities and list it as unindexed when stale unless requestedAt is at or after its mtime. Class a file without entities with the selection seam: not-code and excluded-by-ignore are not stale, selected is stale and listed unless requested, a throwing selection keeps it stale and unlisted. Add the real selection seam to realFreshnessGraphDeps, built on selectFile and resolveRepoIgnore with the parsers loaded. Update the whole-result assertions in freshness.test.ts and add the unit cases.
acceptanceChecks: A file whose mtime is 0 is not stale, not in unindexedFiles, and neither the entity nor the selection seam decides it
A file with no entities and selection not-code or excluded-by-ignore is not stale whatever lastIndexed is; a selected one is in staleFiles and unindexedFiles when never requested
With an idle queue, a file whose watermark is older than its mtime is in staleFiles and unindexedFiles and the selection seam is not consulted for it
A stale file requested at or after its mtime stays in staleFiles but leaves unindexedFiles; a file edited after its request is listed again
A throwing selection seam keeps an entity-less file stale and out of unindexedFiles; the compute calls no write seam
The existing whole-result assertions in freshness.test.ts are updated for unindexedFiles and pass

tests.name: src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/freshness.test.ts: a changed file whose mtime is 0 (deleted or unstattable) is not stale, not in unindexedFiles, and neither the entity nor the selection seam decides it, even when selection would say selected
src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/freshness.test.ts: a file with no entities and selection 'not-code' or 'excluded-by-ignore' is not stale, whatever the repo-level lastIndexed is
src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/freshness.test.ts: a file with no entities and selection 'selected' is in staleFiles and unindexedFiles when it was never requested

src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/freshness.test.ts: with an idle queue, a file with entities whose watermark is older than its mtime (a missed update) is in staleFiles and unindexedFiles, and the selection seam is not consulted for it

src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/freshness.test.ts: a stale file requested at or after its mtime stays in staleFiles but leaves unindexedFiles, with the queue idle or busy, for both an entity-less file and a file with an older watermark
src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/freshness.test.ts: a file edited after its request is in unindexedFiles again
src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/freshness.test.ts: a selection seam that throws keeps an entity-less file stale and out of unindexedFiles
src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/freshness.test.ts: a file with entities whose watermark is at or after its mtime is not stale and not in unindexedFiles; the compute calls no write seam
src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/freshness.test.ts: the existing whole-result assertions are updated for the unindexedFiles field and still pass
